column.name: relevant_product_count
column.description: X: number of top-ranked products per search term assumed relevant, e.g. 6.

column.name: store_name
column.description: Store the calibration query runs against, e.g. DE — picked by the admin at upload time, since Zed has no implicit current store.

column.name: locale_name
column.description: Locale the calibration query runs against, e.g. de_DE — picked by the admin at upload time.

column.name: status
column.description: uploaded, skipped, calculating, calculated or failed.

column.name: computed_k
column.description: Pooled mean text-relevance score across all sampled products; the calculated relevanceSaturationPoint suggestion.

column.name: sample_count
column.description: Total number of pooled product scores the stats were computed from.

column.name: total_count
column.description: Search term count, set once at upload time — the denominator for the live progress counter shown while status=calculating.

column.name: processed_count
column.description: Search terms fired so far in the current/last run — incremented one at a time inside ScoreCalibrator::calculate()'s own per-term loop, the numerator for the live progress counter.

column.name: products_found
column.description: Null until calculated; may be less than the run's relevant_product_count.

column.name: scores
column.description: Comma-separated raw text-relevance scores, one per found product, null until calculated.

column.name: search_term
column.description: Canonical form: trimmed, lowercased, whitespace-collapsed — deliberately NOT tokenized, since real tokenization risks silently merging queries that are actually different asks.

column.name: importance_weight
column.description: Query Curator-editable (SetSearchQueryImportancePermissionPlugin). Flat default of 1 for every query until a human assigns real importance — see README.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: A unique reference for a customer — same convention as spy_product_review.customer_reference, deliberately not a real foreign key to spy_customer (loose coupling across the Client/Zed boundary, standard Spryker pattern).

column.name: rating_type
column.description: heart, check, or x — see SearchRankingOptimizerConfig::RATING_TYPE_*.

column.name: metric_score
column.description: Query-importance-weighted nDCG aggregate across every rated query for this store/locale at this point in time (NOT rank_eval's own top-level metric_score, which is a plain unweighted mean — see RankEvaluationRunner).

column.name: query_count
column.description: How many rated queries actually contributed to this run.

column.name: source
column.description: SearchRankingOptimizerConfig::CHECKPOINT_SOURCE_* — 'manual' for now, later phases add further producers.

column.name: relevance_weight
column.description: search-ranking's relevanceWeight blend at the moment this checkpoint was taken.

column.name: entropy_probe_result_size
column.description: search-ranking's entropyProbeResultSize at the moment this checkpoint was taken (meaningful only if entropy weighting is enabled at the code level, but always captured — cheap and keeps a checkpoint a complete snapshot regardless of that project-level flag).

column.name: entropy_weight_exponent
column.description: search-ranking's entropyWeightExponent at the moment this checkpoint was taken.

column.name: entropy_weight_shift_magnitude
column.description: search-ranking's entropyWeightShiftMagnitude at the moment this checkpoint was taken.

column.name: is_entropy_weighting_enabled
column.description: Whether search-ranking's code-level entropy-weighting flag was on at the moment this checkpoint was taken — independent of the 3 knob values above, so a checkpoint honestly records whether those numbers were actually live, not just what they were set to.

column.name: metric_weights
column.description: JSON array of {idSearchRankingMetric, name, weight} — every metric's own weight at the moment this checkpoint was taken, active or not.

column.name: fk_search_ranking_metric
column.description: Soft reference to search-ranking's own metric id — no hard foreign key, same discipline as spy_search_ranking_weight_checkpoint.metric_weights: the metric could be deleted between config edits and a later run, handled as a safe skip.

column.name: auto_tune_threshold
column.description: R² floor below which the metric is flagged as needing attention. NULL opts the metric out of auto-tune entirely — the default for every metric until an admin explicitly sets one.

column.name: is_auto_update_enabled
column.description: Whether crossing the threshold triggers an automatic refit, or only a proposal/notification.

column.name: auto_update_scope
column.description: SearchRankingOptimizerConfig::AUTO_UPDATE_SCOPE_* — only consulted when is_auto_update_enabled is true.

column.name: is_notify_enabled
column.description: Whether crossing the threshold sends the before/after summary email, independently of is_auto_update_enabled.

column.name: algorithm
column.description: SearchRankingOptimizerConfig::OPTIMIZATION_ALGORITHM_* — which algorithm this run uses.

column.name: status
column.description: SearchRankingOptimizerConfig::OPTIMIZATION_RUN_STATUS_* — queued, running, done or failed.

column.name: total_count
column.description: Total planned candidate evaluations (population size * generations), set once the run actually starts — the denominator for the live progress counter shown while status=running.

column.name: processed_count
column.description: Candidate evaluations completed so far in the current/last run — the numerator for the live progress counter.

column.name: baseline_score
column.description: The live configuration's own weighted nDCG score at the moment this run started, for comparison against the winning candidate — null until the run starts.

column.name: best_relevance_weight
column.description: The winning candidate's relevanceWeight. Null until status=done.

column.name: best_metric_weights
column.description: JSON array of {idSearchRankingMetric, name, weight} for the winning candidate — same shape/encoding as spy_search_ranking_weight_checkpoint.metric_weights. Null until status=done.

column.name: best_score
column.description: The winning candidate's own weighted nDCG score. Null until status=done.
